breakdown.description: It specifies an HCP crystal, but then uses the cubic d-spacing relation. Hexagonal crystals require the hexagonal d-spacing expression.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly replaces the cubic d-spacing formula (d = a/√(h²+k²+l²)) with the proper hexagonal interplanar spacing relation (1/d²_hkl = (4/3)·((h²+hk+k²)/a²) + l²/c²), which is appropriate for HCP crystals. This aligns with the ground truth prompt's instruction to use the hexagonal interplanar-spacing relation.
